units.text: J'ai rencontré beaucoup de gens intéressants.

units.text: Maintenant, j'habite à Toulouse, mais je suis né à Nantes.

translation.en: Now I live in Toulouse, but I was born in Nantes.

units.text: Je suis né à Nantes, j'ai grandi dans un village, puis je me suis installé à Toulouse.

translation.en: I was born in Nantes, I grew up in a village, then I settled in Toulouse.

translation.it: Sono nato a Nantes, sono cresciuto in un paese e poi mi sono stabilito a Tolosa.
